steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/plugin.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/theme.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/file.php';
WP_Filesystem();

delete_plugins( array_keys( get_plugins() ) );

foreach ( array_keys( wp_get_themes() ) as $slug ) {
	if ( ! in_array( $slug, array( get_stylesheet(), get_template() ), true ) ) {
		delete_theme( $slug );
	}
}

<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// US store, no setup wizard or coming-soon mode.
update_option( 'woocommerce_default_country', 'US:KY' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_currency', 'USD' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_coming_soon', 'no' );
update_option( 'woocommerce_onboarding_profile', array( 'skipped' => true ) );

// The bundle brings Shop, Cart, Checkout, My account and Refund and Returns
// Policy: drop the ones
// WooCommerce just created so the imported ones keep their slugs.
foreach ( array( 'shop', 'cart', 'checkout', 'myaccount', 'refund_returns' ) as $page ) {
	$id = (int) get_option( "woocommerce_{$page}_page_id" );
	if ( $id ) {
		wp_delete_post( $id, true );
	}
	delete_option( "woocommerce_{$page}_page_id" );
}

// Sample categories WooCommerce adds on install.
foreach ( array( 'accessories', 'hoodies', 'tshirts' ) as $slug ) {
	$term = get_term_by( 'slug', $slug, 'product_cat' );
	if ( $term ) {
		wp_delete_term( $term->term_id, 'product_cat' );
	}
}

progress.caption: Importing content, media and custom CSS

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/plugin.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/file.php';
global $wpdb;

// importWxr installs wordpress-importer after the plugin cleanup; remove only it.
WP_Filesystem();
deactivate_plugins( 'wordpress-importer/wordpress-importer.php' );
delete_plugins( array( 'wordpress-importer/wordpress-importer.php' ) );

// The importer does not remap non-image attachment URLs (e.g. video.mp4).
// Update the rows directly: wp_update_post() without a logged-in user would
// strip block custom CSS (style.css) through wp_strip_custom_css_from_blocks().
$wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare(
	"UPDATE {$wpdb->posts} SET post_content = REPLACE( post_content, %s, %s )",
	'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gtavarescrimsonagility/profchoice-uploads/main/',
	wp_get_upload_dir()['baseurl'] . '/'
) );
wp_cache_flush();

$homepage = get_page_by_path( 'home' );
if ( $homepage ) {
	update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
	update_option( 'page_on_front', $homepage->ID );
	// The parent theme seeds its own Home page on the first admin load unless
	// it knows the front page.
	update_option( 'cbv_front_page_id', $homepage->ID );
}

// WooCommerce pages from the bundle.
foreach ( array( 'shop' => 'shop', 'cart' => 'cart', 'checkout' => 'checkout', 'myaccount' => 'my-account', 'refund_returns' => 'refund_returns' ) as $page => $path ) {
	$post = get_page_by_path( $path, OBJECT, 'page' ) ?: get_posts( array( 'post_type' => 'page', 'name' => $path, 'post_status' => 'any', 'numberposts' => 1 ) )[0] ?? null;
	if ( $post ) {
		update_option( "woocommerce_{$page}_page_id", $post->ID );
	}
}
